intended_concept: An ordinary open washer aperture contains a deep sea while a woman pauses beside its external door.
input_reference_role: Visible face and short dark bob with fine bangs only; no real identity, age, personality or biography claim.
calibration_claim: none; this is one distinct concept testing the explicit surreal topic with unchanged saved controls

criteria.criterion: A distant sea horizon and near water boundary are visible beyond the real washer gasket, establishing incompatible depth inside an ordinary machine.
criteria.competing_reading: A scenic image printed on a closed round glass door.
criteria.pass_rule: Both deep horizon and near machine boundary must be readable together; a blue patch or ambiguous circular image fails.

criteria.criterion: The outward glass door and its hinge remain separate from the ocean-filled aperture.
criteria.pass_rule: Both door and aperture must be distinguishable; an ambiguous closed scenic door fails.

criteria.criterion: The woman's directed gaze and paused nearby body connect her to the opening.
criteria.pass_rule: A nearby independent portrait with unrelated gaze does not establish the intended discovery.

criteria.criterion: The generated face visually follows the supplied facial appearance and the short dark bob with fine bangs.
criteria.pass_rule: Judge only visible similarity; do not claim identity or exact age.

criteria.criterion: The woman's own hand lightly touches the external open-door rim with readable hand-to-edge contact.
criteria.pass_rule: A hand near the opening or merged with the scene is insufficient.

evidence_layers: retained material inspiration with literal final phrase
strict_review_policy: Any partial or unobservable criterion fails that full criterion; no cross-image composite pass. Requester preference stays pending.
